item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Restore a Faded Family Scan

turns.text: Can you clean up this old family scan and enlarge it to 640 pixels on the long side? Keep the sepia look and everyone's faces the same.

item.tests: Restores and enlarges the supplied scan while preserving identity, historical appearance, and composition.

answer_sheet.Restoration style: Reduce noise and fading gently; keep the original sepia look, not modern colourisation.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: 640 pixels on the long side; preserve the original proportions and full framing.
answer_sheet.Faces and scene: Preserve everyone's identity, expression, clothing, and the original setting.

must_haves: The result depicts the same family and setting as old-photo.jpg, not a replacement family photo.
Visible scan noise is reduced and faded forms have clearer, natural contrast.
The photograph retains its sepia appearance without colourisation.
Faces, expressions, clothing, and framing remain faithful to the source.
The delivered image has a 640-pixel long edge and preserves the source aspect ratio.

turns.text: Can you clean up this old family scan and enlarge it to 640 pixels on the long side? Keep the sepia look and everyone's faces the same.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the restoration because your account has insufficient credits. No image was generated or changed.

Once credits are available, I can retry the cleanup at 640 pixels on the long side, retaining the sepia tone and requesting minimal changes to facial details. AI restoration can subtly alter faces, so exact preservation isn’t guaranteed.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Conservatively restore this old family photograph and enlarge to 640 pixels on its longest side, preserving the original aspect ratio and entire composition. Keep the original warm sepia monochrome look. Gently reduce scan noise, dust, small scratches and fading, improve tonal balance and modestly clarify existing detail without inventing detail. Preserve all four people exactly: identical facial features, expressions, identities, ages, hairstyles, clothing, poses and proportions. Do not beautify, reshape, replace, redraw or modernize any faces. Retain the authentic soft vintage photographic texture; no aggressive sharpening or waxy skin. Keep house, garden and background unchanged. Do not colorize. Faithful archival cleanup rather than reinterpretation.
